THE LONG SHADOW

A short screenplay by Example Writer

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

A bustling coffee shop. Steam rises from the espresso machine.

JANE
I cannot believe you are late again.

MARK
(grinning)
Traffic was a nightmare.

Jane sighs and sips her coffee.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Rain falls hard. Mark and Jane shelter under a bus stop.

MARK
Where do we go from here?

JANE
Somewhere quiet.

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

They sit in silence, windshield wipers beating time.

MARK
Do you think we made the right choice?

The car pulls away into the night.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAWN

First light over the skyline. Jane stands at the edge.

JANE
I will handle this alone.

Mark watches, torn, then nods.

FADE OUT.
